text:
eli (SE): Heads-up 12: Zenith Health wants a 3-week POC starting next Tue. Main asks: predictable monthly reserved pricing, throughput sizing for their peak (about 10k rps with ~700 token avg), and KMS/BYOK + HSM confirmation.

maria (AE): they care about predictable run-rate, finance won't accept burst-only. also asked for log retention and EU data residency.

rahul (Solutions): quick sketch: for their profile (chat-like, 700 tokens avg), recommended reserved pool = 4 x rtx6000-equivalent GPUs. autoscale headroom to 6 for spikes. With quantized FP8-ish workloads we get ~1.5-1.7x throughput; we'll show both footprints.

eli (SE): can we put that into a 1-page table: 4 reserved vs 6 reserved vs 2 reserved + burst credits (monthly $)? they want numbers for procurement.

rahul (Solutions): rough numbers now (final calc in ticket): 4 reserved ~= $28k/mo, 6 reserved ~= $40.6k/mo, 2 reserved + burst ~= $24k/mo (but note: queueing risk, 25% higher p99). I'll run exact token-cost and infra margin.

anya (Security): from questionnaire: KMS with CMK and HSM wrapping required, SOC2 + ISO certs, 12 month audit log retention, and EU region hosting. Hosted tier covers SOC2; HSM is enterprise add-on (BYOK/HSM via partner).

maria (AE): customer prefers Dedicated in eu-west-1 to simplify residency and KMS. Can we propose Dedicated + enterprise security pack? include legal addendum for HSM/BYOK.

rahul (Solutions): Dedicated is good. Ops plan: reserved pool in single AZ with cross-AZ failover. Autoscale policy suggestion: min_replicas=4, target_gpu_util=0.65, max_replicas=6, cooldown=120s. Prewarm: KV cache warmup + synthetic ramp.

eli (SE): share the prewarm snippet please. we need to document smoke test too.

rahul (Solutions): snippet: ```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 6
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.65
  cooldown_seconds: 120
prewarm:
  kv_warmup: true
  concurrency: 10
  ramp_seconds: 900
```

rahul (Solutions): smoke test plan: synthetic ramp 0 -> 10k rps over 15m, capture p50/p95/p99 and token-cost.csv per model variant. example load command: ```bash
loadgen --target 10000 --ramp 900 --payload=chat_700.json --capture=p99 --report=token_cost.csv
```

maria (AE): timeline: questionnaire answers by EOD Fri, pricing sheet + 3 options by Mon, infra deploy Tue. Can team hit that?

anya (Security): I'll draft KMS/BYOK/HSM answers and attach SOC2 evidence. Also confirm log retention options for Dedicated vs Hosted: Dedicated supports 12mo with enterprise pack; Hosted default 90 days.

infra_bot: Created ticket SRV-9207  "Zenith Health POC: reserved plan + security pack" assigned to rahul, due 2026-04-02.

eli (SE): rahul, please include cost sensitivity when customers use quantized runtime (throughput boost). call out pricing bins for quantized vs full-precision.

rahul (Solutions): will add a small appendix with quantized throughput multipliers (x1.6 for 8-bit q8, x1.3 for q4) and cost-per-1k-responses at 512/700 tokens.

maria (AE): legal: forward the questionnaire and ask for HSM addendum template. I'll coordinate finance for PO desk numbers.

anya (Security): ping me if you need screenshots of our KMS integration and key rotation logs. I'll also include a note about BYOK key wraps via partner HSMs.

eli (SE): thanks team. I'll sync with the customer after we have the pricing sheet. End.
